DIY Accounting Submit

How to file small company accounts at Companies House

File your company's annual accounts online from your own figures

Submit turns the figures you give it into small company accounts and files them with Companies House. You choose the accounting period, enter the figures, check the answers and file.

File small company accounts

  • Price: £9.99 a year or £0.99 a month for the Resident Ltd bundle.
  • Due: A private limited company files its annual accounts with Companies House within 9 months of the end of its financial year.

What you need before you start

  • Your company number.
  • The accounting period and the figures for the format you choose: full accounts, or filleted accounts.
  • The name of the director who approves the balance sheet, and the date of approval.
  • A Google or Microsoft account to sign in to Submit.

The steps

  1. Find the company

    Choose File Small Company Accounts (Companies House) on the activities page.

  2. Enter the company number

    Enter your company number.

  3. Look up the company

    Choose Look up company.

  4. Confirm the company name

    Check that the company name Companies House shows is yours.

  5. Set the accounting period

    Enter the first and last day of the accounting period as Period start and Period end.

  6. This year's profit and loss

    Enter the profit and loss figures for this year, starting with turnover.

  7. Profit worked out

    Check the gross profit, operating profit and profit for the year that Submit works out.

  8. The balance sheet

    Enter this year's balance sheet, starting with fixed assets and going on to what the company owes.

  9. Net assets must balance

    Check that the net assets shown equal your capital and reserves.

  10. Add last year

    Tick Include prior-year comparatives to add last year's figures.

  11. Describe the company

    Enter the principal activity, the accounting policies and the average number of employees.

  12. Name the directors

    Enter the directors who held office during the period, one name on each line.

  13. Name the approving director

    Enter the name of the director approving the accounts and the date of approval.

  14. Accept the statements

    Tick each statutory statement that applies to your company, starting with the audit exemption under section 477.

  15. Preview

    Choose Preview accounts, then read the accounts as they will be filed. Nothing is sent to Companies House yet.

  16. File it

    Enter the company's authentication code and check the cost, one token, then choose Submit to Companies House.

  17. Companies House checks it

    Wait while Companies House checks the filing.

  18. Companies House has the filing

    Read the status that Companies House reports for the filing.

  19. Open your copy

    Choose See your copy of this filing.

  20. The filed accounts

    Read your copy: the filed accounts, the submission number and the status.

  21. Kept on your receipts

    Find your copy of the filing on the Receipts page whenever you need it.

Price

The Resident Ltd bundle covers this filing and costs £9.99 a year or £0.99 a month.

When it is due

A private limited company files its annual accounts with Companies House within 9 months of the end of its financial year.

File annual accounts with Companies House 9 months after your company’s financial year ends

Source: GOV.UK, Accounts and tax returns for private limited companies: Overview (checked 13 November 2026)
